title: tapenade
instructions: Place the anchovies, garlic and capers in a food processor. Add the black olives and pulse until coarsely chopped. Drizzle in the olive oil and lemon juice. Blend until it forms a coarse paste. Serve on toasted bread right before serving.

title: classic banana bread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Mash the bananas in a bowl. Stir the melted butter into the mashed bananas. Mix in the sugar, egg and vanilla. Sprinkle the baking soda over the mixture and stir. Add the flour and combine. Pour the batter into a greased loaf pan. Bake for 50 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.

title: fresh guacamole
instructions: Mash the avocados in a bowl. Add the garlic, lime juice and onion. Stir in the cilantro and season with salt. Blend until it forms a coarse paste. Serve with tortilla chips right before serving.

title: simple marinara sauce
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a pan. Add the garlic and cook until fragrant. Pour in the crushed tomatoes and stir. Season with basil, salt and pepper. Simmer for 20 minutes until thickened. Serve over pasta.

title: classic hummus
instructions: Drain the chickpeas and add to a food processor. Add the tahini, garlic and lemon juice. Pour in the olive oil and pulse until smooth. Season with salt and blend into a paste. Serve drizzled with olive oil.

title: fluffy pancakes
instructions: Whisk the flour, sugar and baking soda in a bowl. Beat in the egg, milk and melted butter until smooth. Pour batter onto a hot greased griddle. Cook until bubbles form then flip. Cook until golden brown. Serve warm with syrup.
